continuous.route_down: bilinear interpolation onto the coarse cell centres
continuous.route_down_crosscheck: area-weighted block average, the route used everywhere else in the report
continuous.support: coarse cells whose centre falls inside the 2 m study domain

measures.agreement: fraction of coarse cells whose class equals the majority class of the 2 m cells inside the same block
measures.kappa: Cohen kappa, agreement after removing what chance alone gives
measures.cramers_v: Cramer's V from the full class-by-class contingency table, zero means no association and one means perfect association
measures.why: Landuse carries a nominal code and Building_binary is a flag, so a product-moment correlation has no meaning for either of them

flood.speed_definition: speed = |(hux,hvy)|/h, evaluated at the hour with the largest domain water volume; these are derived quantities, not stored fields.
flood.fit_note: families are fitted by maximum likelihood on a random subsample of at most one hundred thousand wet cells, with the location parameter fixed at zero, seed 20260921

regionalisation.unit: 2 m cells of the study domain
regionalisation.feature: log(1 + value) of that resolution's own simulated field
regionalisation.scaling: each resolution's log field is centred and scaled by its own mean and standard deviation on the common support, so the comparison is about spatial pattern rather than about the overall level
regionalisation.algorithm: KMeans with one feature, KMeans++ initialisation
regionalisation.k_choice: silhouette score over K = 3 to 8, evaluated on the 2 m reference field
regionalisation.label_projection: a coarse label is carried to the 2 m cells inside its block by nearest neighbour, which keeps each block label intact
regionalisation.support: the common support is the 2 m cells whose own value and the value of every coarse field at that cell all exceed the wet threshold, so no dry coarse value is ever set against a wet 2 m value
regionalisation.metric: V-measure, the harmonic mean of homogeneity and completeness, computed from its definition
regionalisation.sabre_note: SABRE is an R package and this machine has no R runtime, so its implementation cannot be called. The V-measure definition is unique, so computing it directly gives the same quantity.

families.chance_corrected: Adjusted Rand Index, Fowlkes-Mallows, Normalized and Adjusted Mutual Information, and Cohen kappa beside the V-measure
families.areal: per-cluster intersection over union after best matching, and the total-variation distance of the area shares
families.boundary: wet-mask boundary F1, boundary IoU and modified Hausdorff distance between wet fronts, the front being read off a depth field in metres
families.autocorrelation: Moran's I and Geary's C of the field and of the ordered class labels, plus a join-count statistic
families.distance_resolved: agreement against the 2 m reference resolved by depth band and by distance to the nearest channel

front_diagnostic.note: front read off the speed field itself with the same absolute 0.05 threshold, kept only to show why the reported family uses a depth field
